d.ko: Play cards and pool with your friends or meet new opponents in a dive bar where every match is a new challenge! Test your strategy in 4 game modes: Capote, Truco, Pool and Betejack. Here victory is never guaranteed, and there's always a card (or a shot) that can change everything!
